about: What is drawn on screen. Sprites and the font come from the player's Once Upon A KATAMARI when the converter found them (extract ouak_hud / ouak_font); otherwise the element is drawn plainly with a system font.

rows.draw: Katamari's size display (its own sprites and layout when found): live size in cm/m, ring filling toward the next mark.
Goal size under the size display.
Time left as m:ss; turns red in the last minute.
Goal line for the first 4 seconds.
Time's up, final size, success or not, how to roll again.
How many things are rolled up.
Missing or unreadable game message, until dismissed with any key.
